apiKeys.description: Let a program, such as a script or an AI agent, use Board Keeper as you. An API key can do what you can, except admin work and changing how you sign in.

exportAndImport.title: Export and import
exportAndImport.description: Move Board Keeper's games, players and plays to another installation.

export.title: Export
export.text: Saves every game, player and play in one file, which another Board Keeper can import. It holds nothing about accounts, so it is no backup: back up the database for that. Should the database be lost all the same, importing an export brings back the plays.

import.title: Import
import.text: Adds the plays of an export from another Board Keeper, with the players and games they need. Plays that are here already stay as they are.
import.backupFirst: An import can't be undone, so back up the database first.
import.alreadyHere_one: {{count}} play is here already and stays as it is
import.alreadyHere_other: {{count}} plays are here already and stay as they are
import.whoIsWhoHint: Choose who each player of the export is here. Board Keeper suggests who they most likely are: the player in their place in a play that is here already, or else the player with the same name.
